protocol.purpose: Controlled snapshot attention comparison followed by trajectory-history ablation
protocol.augmentation: One common lateral reflection sign per sample and all its history frames
protocol.inference: Equal-weight three-seed ensemble, mirror averaging for each seed
protocol.snapshot_control: Same current features, target, match splits, group-mean pooling and bounded output as frozen GNN; parameter counts within 2%
protocol.history_control: Same transformer weights and parameter count across conditions; history versus repeated current values at the same observed-history masks for current players
protocol.time_encoder: Player-aligned trajectory attention before current spatial blocks; shares projections with first spatial block
protocol.target: Signed first future shot transferred geometry-xG in (t,t+15s], including interruptions
protocol.selection: Choose gnn, snapshot or history by validation ensemble MSE; repeat is diagnostic only
protocol.uncertainty: Exact whole-match descriptive bootstrap, 27 ordered resamples of three test matches
protocol.scope: Previously consumed test matches; exploratory comparison, not a fresh confirmatory test or a causal tactical claim

limitations: Previously examined three-match test set: exploratory architectural comparison.
Transferred geometric xG labels; teacher calibration on SkillCorner is unverified.
Common optimizer is a controlled budget, not exhaustive tuning of every architecture.
Temporal encoder uses aligned individual trajectories before spatial attention, not a full historical interaction graph.
Repeat control retains historical visibility for currently visible players; contrast isolates trajectory values conditional on coverage.
Only three match clusters; descriptive intervals omit retraining and xG-source uncertainty.
